fossilMappings.evolutionSummary: Anorith evolves into Armaldo at level 40.

fossilMappings.evolutionSummary: Shieldon evolves into Bastiodon at level 30.
fossilMappings.guideSummary: A defensive Rock/Steel wall with excellent bulk but low offensive pressure.

fossilMappings.evolutionSummary: Tirtouga evolves into Carracosta at level 37.
fossilMappings.guideSummary: A bulky physical attacker that can become dangerous after Shell Smash.

fossilMappings.evolutionSummary: Archen evolves into Archeops at level 37.
fossilMappings.guideSummary: A fast mixed attacker with excellent offenses but a limiting ability.

fossilMappings.evolutionSummary: Tyrunt evolves into Tyrantrum at level 39 during the daytime.
fossilMappings.guideSummary: A straightforward physical Dragon/Rock attacker with strong biting moves.

fossilMappings.evolutionSummary: Amaura evolves into Aurorus at level 39 during the nighttime.
fossilMappings.guideSummary: A slower special attacker with Ice coverage and several defensive weaknesses.

fossilMappings.guideSummary: One half of two Galar fossil combinations in Pokemon Sword and Shield.
